facts.text: Interstellar Dust & Cosmic Ray Detector was deployed at Interstellar Trajectory — Aldebaran & Aquila during Pioneer 10 & 11 in 1972.
Solid-state silicon detector telescope measuring high-energy galactic cosmic ray protons and alpha particles entering the Solar System.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Measured the intensity gradient of cosmic rays originating from distant supernovas beyond the Sun's protective bubble.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Interstellar Trajectory — Aldebaran & Aquila.
Provided humanity's first direct in-situ measurement of raw interstellar cosmic rays.
